pairs.question: Quorum igitur causa quis dixerit effectum esse mundum?
pairs.answer: Eorum scilicet animantium, quae ratione utuntur; hi sunt di et homines.
pairs.derivation: Balbus poses and answers his own question about the purpose of the world. The interrogative 'Quorum igitur causa quis dixerit effectum esse mundum?' is taken verbatim; the immediately preceding clauses (arborumne... an bestiarum...) raise and reject alternatives and are dropped as setup, leaving the operative question. The answer begins at the reply 'Eorum scilicet...' and is cut at the first full stop equivalent: the span 'Eorum scilicet animantium, quae ratione utuntur; hi sunt di et homines' is the direct answer (identifying for whom). The continuation 'quibus profecto nihil est melius; ratio est enim, quae praestet omnibus' (separated only by semicolons) elaborates why and is omitted; terminal semicolon normalized to a full stop.
